K.M.RESHMI, SR.GP  THIS WRIT PETITION (CIVIL) HAVING COME UP FOR ADMISSION ON 07.11.2025, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 2025:KER:84968 WP(C) No.18065 of 2025  3  JUDGMENT Dated this the 7th day of November, 2025 1.
The petitioner has filed this writ petition seeking direction to the first respondent Bank to de-freeze her account maintained with said bank.

2. The learned counsel for the 3rd respondent with reference to counter affidavit filed by the 3 rd respondent contended that the petitioner herself is an accused in the Crime No.554/2023 registered in the Cyber Crime Police Station, Hyderabad, under Sections 66C & 66D of the Information Sheeja A vs South Indian Bank on 7 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/98290161/
2 Technology Act and under Sections 419 and 420 of the Indian Penal Code.

entities.text: Information Sheeja A vs South Indian Bank
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The counter affidavit of the 3rd respondent specifically stated that an amount of Rs.13,00,000/- is transferred to the two separate accounts of the petitioner, and the said amount is part of the amount involved in the said crime.
The petitioner was arrested on 03.07.2023 for the said crime and she was produced before the XII ACMM, NAMPALLY, Hyderabad.
The petitioner filed this writ petition 2025:KER:84968 without disclosing her involvement in the crime, her arrest, and the transfer of the amount to her account.
On the said ground alone, this writ petition is liable to be dismissed, apart from her involvement in the crime.
Accordingly, this writ petition is dismissed.
